summary: Build a clean, modern, responsive landing page for "RashidaAi: AI Made Easy" Bootcamp to drive waitlist signups for the Feb 14, 2026 4-week cohort, featuring syllabus content, an interactive preview, countdown timer, FAQ accordion, and a chatbot, using a vibrant turquoise/hot pink/purple color palette.
architectural_notes: Landing page should be mobile-first and responsive across breakpoints.
Countdown timer should be date-driven (Feb 14, 2026) to avoid manual updates.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Abstract vibrant gradient hero background with subtle geometric shapes in turquoise, hot pink, and purple (rashidaai-hero-bg.dim_1920x1080.png)
- Minimal modern logo mark for “RashidaAi” using turquoise/hot pink/purple on transparent background (rashidaai-logo.dim_512x512.png)
- Simple chatbot icon button graphic in the same palette on transparent background (rashidaai-chat-icon.dim_256x256.png)
- Favicon version of the logo mark, high contrast and readable at small sizes (rashidaai-favicon.dim_64x64.png)

existing_features.title: Build a clean, modern, fully responsive landing page for “RashidaAi: AI Made Easy Bootcamp” using a vibrant turquoise + hot pink + purple color palette, with clear sectioning and strong calls-to-action for joining the waitlist.
Add a Waitlist signup form that allows visitors to enter and submit their information for the Feb 14, 2026 4-week bootcamp waitlist.
Add an enrollment countdown timer that counts down to February 14, 2026, displaying days/hours/minutes/seconds and handling the event-started state gracefully.
Create a Syllabus section that presents the bootcamp curriculum clearly (e.g., week-by-week for a 4-week program), with scannable headings and bullet points.
Add an “interactive preview” component for the course (e.g., clickable tabs/cards per week that reveal sample lesson details) without requiring external services.
Add an FAQ accordion section with multiple questions and expandable answers.
Include a chatbot widget on the landing page that can answer common bootcamp questions using a local scripted flow (no external LLM/API calls), and can direct users to the waitlist form.
Add generated brand visuals as static assets and use them on the landing page (hero/branding area and/or favicon), stored under frontend/public/assets/generated.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create responsive landing page for RashidaAi: AI Made Easy Bootcamp with modern, clean design and vibrant turquoise/hot pink/purple palette
Add syllabus section and an interactive preview component for the course content
Implement enrollment countdown timer targeting Feb 14, 2026 bootcamp start date
Include chatbot widget on the landing page
Add waitlist signup option with form to collect and submit user information
